integrity: Exact algebraic proof and root-sign certificates are included; reproducibility uses Python 3 and SymPy. No claim of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Only a zero-rate derivative tricritical root in the specified antipodal two-site circle geometry, its reflection, and a local small-positive-rate stationary minimum. No global optimal-rate uniqueness or all-geometry classification. Numerical coordinates of the point were published previously; the new algebraic and nondegeneracy statements are compared to accessible literature, but independent priority remains open.
title: Exact algebraic tricritical point in two-site Brownian resetting on a circle
